title: Understanding Zero-One Loss
text: The zero-one loss function is different from cross-entropy loss because it considers both the model parameters and the threshold. Think about how changing the threshold might affect the accuracy of your predictions.

title: Maximizing Accuracy
text: When we talk about maximizing accuracy, we're looking at the proportion of correctly predicted labels. Consider how the choice of threshold T can influence whether predictions are classified correctly.

hintAnswer: It changes the decision boundary, affecting which predictions are classified as $$1$$ or $$0$$.
title: Threshold's Role in Accuracy
text: How does adjusting the threshold T affect the accuracy of a binary classifier?
choices: It changes the decision boundary, affecting which predictions are classified as $$1$$ or $$0$$.
It has no effect on the predictions.
It only affects the model's complexity.
